key_insight: VHamilton represents variational evolution times as open clocks, enabling exact reasoning and compiler equivalence proofs across all clock valuations.
engineering_relevance: Preserving Hamiltonian structure supports verified circuit rewrites, commuting-block fusion, precision-error bounds, and spectrum-informed parameter search.
method: Instantiate open clocks with exact dyadic times to obtain ordinary Hamilton programs that compile to circuits.
Mechanize finite equivalence checks in Agda for a fragment, proving rzz(t) = cx; rz(t); cx for every clock value.
Evaluate a two-qubit chemistry eigensolver with a Haskell prototype and coordinate search.
evidence_signal: On the benchmark, coordinate search reached the numerically verified optimum of a 134-million-valuation grid in 53 energy queries, but found the grid optimum in only 21 of 30 validation settings.
watch_item: The search improvement is conditional, not a global-optimization guarantee, and the mechanized proofs cover only a language fragment.
